name: DigitalOcean
description: DigitalOcean is a cloud platform for deploying and operating infrastructure and applications. Teams use Projects to organize resources such as Droplets and App Platform apps.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact DigitalOcean Team, Project, and selected Droplet or App through Relay's confidential OAuth client with only the seven current required granular read scopes, then let agents list bounded Projects and Project resources and inspect the selected resource after membership verification. Relay V1 excludes credentials, environment values, user data, logs, console, source, sensitive products, writes, administration, arbitrary REST, alias scopes, and pagination.

approvalRequired.label: Read selected Project

approvalRequired.label: List Project resources

approvalRequired.label: Read selected resource

blocked.label: Change DigitalOcean resources
blocked.description: Creation, update, assignment, action, deployment, restart, scale, transfer, and deletion are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read sensitive data
blocked.description: Credentials, environment values, user data, logs, console, source and repository metadata, registries, databases, Kubernetes credentials, Spaces, and secrets are outside V1.

blocked.label: Administer DigitalOcean
blocked.description: Team members, roles, billing, invoices, OAuth applications, tokens, SSH keys, domains, certificates, and administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use raw DigitalOcean API
blocked.description: Arbitrary REST, hosts, paths, queries, cursors, pagination, aliases such as api:read, and raw responses are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All four bounded DigitalOcean reads require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All four selected read-only tools run without Relay per-action approval while exact Team/Project/resource binding, fixed requests, limits, redaction, audit, serialized refresh, and provider limits remain enforced.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's confidential DigitalOcean OAuth application, exact Railway callback, seven required granular read scopes, and staging client credentials require provider-console completion and authorized staging acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register the confidential OAuth application with Relay's exact Railway callback, configure all seven required read scopes and staging credentials, then validate Team/Project/resource binding, refresh-pair rotation, revoke, denial, and all four bounded reads.

evidence.supports: DigitalOcean documents confidential authorization-code OAuth, CSRF state, 30-day access tokens, single-use rotating refresh tokens, Team identity in the grant, fixed endpoints, and revocation.
DigitalOcean documents project:read as the Project read scope and distinguishes associated resource scopes from global expanding aliases.
DigitalOcean documents droplet:read and its required regions:read, sizes:read, actions:read, and image:read dependencies.
DigitalOcean documents app:read and its required regions:read, sizes:read, and actions:read dependencies.
DigitalOcean documents first-page Project resource listing, resource URNs, per_page/page bounds, and resource-scope filtering.
